Top 3 products by total revenue all-time, using the Revenue definition in the KPI docs. Return list[{product:str, revenue:float}].

outputs.constraints:
FORMULA Revenue [unspecified]: SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity * (1 - Discount)) computed from order line items, using the line item unit price at time of sale, not the current catalog price
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.

inputs.question: Top 3 products by total revenue all-time, using the Revenue definition in the KPI docs. Return list[{product:str, revenue:float}].

outputs.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - IFNULL(od.Discount, 0))) as revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - IFNULL(od.Discount, 0))) DESC LIMIT 3
